question: At RH of about 33% and 28 C, by how many percentage points did the share of coffee-ring deposits change when the magnetic field was applied?
expect: +40 points: 40.0% zero field to 80% with the field (Table 3)
rendered: According to the text, at RH ≈ 33% and T = 28 °C (zero field), the percentage of coffee-ring deposits was 40.0%. When the magnetic field was applied, the percentage of coffee-ring deposits was 50.0%. Therefore, the share of coffee-ring deposits changed by 10 percentage points.
